scope: 13 news articles and 9 release notes; 13 locales; source/Chinese editorial review plus cross-locale structural cleanup. This is an editorial review, not an independent replication of reported experiments.

reviews.autopso: Retained method, experiments and captions; removed QR/caption and compacted resource links.
reviews.codex-for-evox: Reframed title as a demonstrated development workflow in all locales; fixed Chinese duplicated wording and arbitrary-code phrasing; retained reproducibility context and operation screenshots.
reviews.evococo: Retained technical narrative, data and experiment figures; removed QQ and upstream promotion; standardized resource links.
reviews.evogm: Removed repeated H1 and QR; normalized paper/code links and captions; retained seen/unseen-task scope.
reviews.evogo: Reframed headline, removed repeated opening abstract and physics/philosophy detour across locales; retained methods, benchmarks and wing-design evidence.
reviews.evogp: Converted visual bold labels to semantic sections; standardized figure captions and resources; removed QR.
reviews.evorl: Rewrote all translations to describe evolutionary/RL composition and modular experiments; removed unsupported financial-use, universal improvement and environment-gradient claims.
reviews.evox-genesis: Removed centered wrappers, platform promo and QR; retained application UI and result figures; removed unsupported declining-unit-cost projection while preserving cache result.
reviews.evox-quickstart: Transcribed five code images to code blocks and removed the duplicate sixth image; preserved original tutorial API/example commands without claiming execution; corrected copied EvoMO resources and removed promo/QR.
reviews.genesis-wasm-render: Retained challenge description, reported test counts, differing comparison durations and implementation resources; applied shared typography.
reviews.gpu-accelerated-emo: Corrected EMl-Group typo; removed QR/upstream promo; preserved method diagrams, including the technically relevant evox-1-1-2-1.png asset.
reviews.istratde: Removed repeated heading and QR; preserved fixed-strategy construction, reachability qualification and experimental sections; paper title moved into disclosure.
reviews.metade: Fixed accidental indented prose, inline spacer and malformed emphasis; simplified meta-evolution explanation in English/Chinese; removed promo/QR and compacted resources.
reviews.evox-1-0-0: Removed unqualified 100x statement and rewrote summary in all locales; retained algorithm and PyTorch features.
reviews.evox-1-1-0: Rewrote all locales around compiler change and workflow compilation; corrected universal Python/library compatibility promise.
reviews.evox-1-1-1: Normalized headings and nested wording; corrected copied MetaDE resources; removed QR.
reviews.evox-1-1-2: Preserved changelog and initial distributed-support scope; corrected copied MetaDE resources and removed QR.
reviews.evox-1-2-0: Preserved release features and contributor/PR references; normalized headings; corrected footer copied from EvoMO and removed QR.
reviews.evox-1-2-1: Preserved feature and bug-fix details; nested utility examples; corrected copied footer and removed QR.
reviews.evox-1-2-2: Preserved concise fixes and changelog; shared short-article layout without a redundant one-entry TOC.
reviews.evox-1-3-0: Preserved feature and fix sections and changelog; shared article typography and resources.
reviews.evox-1-4-0: Preserved historical maintenance announcement, Genesis context and changelog; shared short-article layout.
